root_causes.root_cause: _enrich_image_blocks in client.py does not propagate skipped_reason or decorative flags from PictureResult to image blocks. When _recover_picture_text correctly skips a region (decorative_icon filter for sub-20pt elements, OCR min-chars gate yielding decorative=True, page_coverage, clip_text_already_exported), the resulting PictureResult carries the skip metadata but _enrich_image_blocks only writes page/bbox/ocr_text/description/figure_path -- never the skip reason. Image blocks end up with page=0, bbox={} and no explanation of why they lack enrichment. Audit scoring then counts these as unenriched gaps even though the skip was correct and no content was lost. This affects both GHV-TKV-Tarif (3/4 decorative animal silhouettes/logo) and Unfallversicherung (60/63 small table-cell icons/checkmarks correctly filtered by decorative_icon or empty-OCR gate).
root_causes.code_path: src/pageindex_mcp/client.py::_enrich_image_blocks -> converters.py::_recover_picture_text -> decorative_icon filter / OCR min-chars gate
root_causes.suggested_fix: In _enrich_image_blocks (client.py line ~737), after matching a PictureResult to a block, propagate pr.get('skipped_reason') and pr.get('decorative') onto the block dict. E.g.: if pr.get('skipped_reason'): block['skipped_reason'] = pr['skipped_reason']; if pr.get('decorative'): block['decorative'] = True. Then update classify_verdict's image_enrichment_promoted path in helpers.py to exclude blocks tagged decorative/skipped from the unenriched count, so correctly-skipped decorative icons no longer degrade the verdict.
